_readme: Synthetic demo tenant v3 — the Wolds Link, a fictional ~32 km A-road dualling scheme in the East Midlands, as a four-year programme (Jan 2026 – Dec 2030; the north opens Dec 2028, the whole road Oct 2029). Nothing in it is anyone's data. Import into an EMPTY tenant (POST /api/admin/tenant/import; replace=1 over an older demo), then bake the network (HERE) for EVERY planning vehicle the lines use (Artic Tipper, Artic Flatbed, and the two concrete mixers on the batching plants' routes) — routes read UNBAKED until then, and the A47 closure only re-routes what is baked while it is in force. History (actuals, the account week, day actuals, confirmations, stockpile draw) is typed up to 2026-11-26 (the generator's --as-of). Diesel index: fetched automatically from DESNZ weekly road fuel prices (H1); fuel_index below is a typed placeholder applied on import if the GB row is empty. Distances read in miles (tenant.distance_unit); km is what is stored. tenant.demo_notice puts 'DEMO · Fictional scheme' on every screen and export. The council areas ship in the package (D102) and the carbon target too (D105). Carbon planner: Langton Compound's surplus cut goes to a fictional inert landfill; a fictional soil-recycling hub nearer by has a route and no forecast — the disposal alternative. The asphalt plant's crushed rock rides its own category with no material carbon (D112). The two electric lorry profiles are scenario-only: they read the diesel twin's baked distances and are never offered on a forecast.
